findings.claim: Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false). Descendant credit is recorded joint-head survival credit, not decoded terminal affinity. Survival enrichment z-scores are small (e.g., landmark_00_soft_mass 0.365, landmark_09_local_czz -0.390, landmark_14_local_czz -0.308, landmark_15_local_czz -0.399, landmark_12_local_czz -1.549, landmark_19_local_czz -1.584) and BH-adjusted q values are mostly non-significant. Last-record survival credit must not be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-selection versus descendant-credit comparison is unavailable.

Immediate endpoint selection evidence is strong and batch-consistent for pair_kernel_1.5 (integrated z 0.562, positive_batch_fraction 1.0, q 1.5e-4), pair_kernel_2.5 (0.631, 1.0, q 2.2e-5), pair_kernel_3.5 (0.540, 1.0, q 9.8e-5), pair_kernel_5.0 (0.319, 0.857, q 3.7e-3), landmark_00_occupancy3 (0.545, 1.0, q 2.4e-4), landmark_06_softmin (0.294, 1.0, q 6.8e-4), landmark_18_softmin (0.264, 0.857, q 6.0e-3), and negative for pair_kernel_7.0 (-0.485, 0.0, q 1.5e-4), landmark_00_softmin (-0.481, 0.0, q 8.1e-4), shape_yy (-0.513, 0.0, q 1.5e-5), shape_xx (-0.495, 0.071, q 8.1e-4). These are endpoint forecast descriptors, not physical interaction energies.

Branch-adjusted covariance and correlation diagnostics show joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A are the most batch-consistent negative associations (adjusted_correlation -0.150 and -0.137, positive_batch_fraction 0.929 and 1.0, q 2.8e-4 and 9.7e-4; adjusted_covariance q 0.020 and 0.030). pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 remain positive under adjustment (adjusted_correlation 0.101 and 0.084, q 0.019 and 0.019). These are adjusted branch diagnostics, not rigid-motion residuals or causal effects.

Joint diagnostics separate local coordinate information from global pose: selection_innovation/observed_child_score_gain is negative (mean -0.036, positive_batch_fraction 0.0, q 1.8e-7), while innovation_native_alignment (0.092, 1.0, q 2.2e-9) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (0.226, 1.0, q 2.2e-9) are positive. Teacher contrast is predominantly internal (internal_fraction 0.787) with translation 0.132 and rotation 0.081, and atom participation 0.384. These are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit.

Supplied continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations over support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed=false. They show many sign changes (e.g., landmark_00_local_dx 6, landmark_00_local_dy 6, landmark_00_local_cxy 9, landmark_01_local_cxy 7, landmark_01_local_cyz 7) and strong sign conflicts (up to 18 for landmark_01_local_cxy and landmark_01_local_cyz), with relative_node_RMSE often 0.4-1.0. A constant rule versus a time-conditioned rule cannot be resolved from these curves; no arbitrary time bins or extrapolation are supported. A contrast curve is not an absolute reward target.

Turnover accounting separates population-contrast changes from parent-child increment contrasts. For landmark_00_soft_mass, edge_rate is 4.545 (q 0.142) and turnover_residual_rate is -4.360 (q 0.142). Large positive turnover_residual_rate values appear for landmark_00_local_cxx (4.286, q 0.038), landmark_00_local_cyy (5.051, q 0.033), landmark_04_local_cxx (5.671, q 0.012), landmark_07_local_cxx (5.076, q 0.012), landmark_07_local_cyy (5.633, q 0.019), landmark_08_local_cxx (5.543, q 0.012), landmark_16_local_cyy (6.367, q 0.012), landmark_19_local_cxx (5.298, q 0.012), landmark_19_local_cyy (5.368, q 0.031). The residual is an accounting diagnostic including reclassification and parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

Parent-child increment contrasts are mostly weak and inconsistent: landmark_00_softmin success_failure_integrated_rate_z -4.914 (q 0.046), landmark_00_occupancy3 4.277 (q 0.081), shape_xx -3.698 (q 0.095), shape_yy -3.845 (q 0.161), shape_xz 3.004 (q 0.207), pair_kernel_2.5 3.965 (q 0.208), pair_kernel_7.0 -3.139 (q 0.208), landmark_03_occupancy5 -3.016 (q 0.161), landmark_06_occupancy5 -2.869 (q 0.256), landmark_16_occupancy3 -1.754 (q 0.222). These do not establish within-path change versus changing cohort composition.

The information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092), compressed_choice_fixed_RMS_A 0.564 (CI 0.499-0.620), compressed_choice_proper_rigid_RMS_A 0.529 (CI 0.468-0.582), top4_teacher_overlap 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515), compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140), and full_chosen_teacher_score_correlation 0.064 (CI 0.021-0.103). The audit states these are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, nonnegative excess distance is by construction, and teacher score correlations are observational, not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor.

Curve fidelity audit selects 24 curves under rules relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0, quiet_node_large_fit_fraction_le 0.1, absolute_integrated_z_ge 0.1, batch_direction_fraction_ge 0.857, q_lt 0.05. For landmark_00 features, relative_node_rmse ranges 0.286-0.867 and strong_sign_conflict_nodes ranges 1-14, with legendre_runtime_allowed=false throughout. Fits are not validated as causal benefit or gradients.

Regional enrichment z-scores show soft_mass positive at landmark_00 (0.639, q 1.9e-4), local_dy positive at landmark_02 (0.405, q 1.3e-4), landmark_06 (0.425, q 5.7e-7), landmark_09 (0.325, q 1.2e-5), landmark_14 (0.350, q 3.4e-6), landmark_18 (0.425, q 9.2e-6), and local_cyy negative across many landmarks (e.g., landmark_00 -0.575, landmark_07 -0.646, landmark_16 -0.672, landmark_19 -0.622). Parent-edge contrast rates are large and negative for local_cxx and local_cyy at many landmarks (e.g., landmark_07_local_cxx -4.691, landmark_08_local_cxx -5.116, landmark_16_local_cyy -5.903, landmark_19_local_cxx -4.822, landmark_19_local_cyy -4.385). These are enrichment diagnostics, not physical interaction energies.

Global centroid and shape raw covariance effects are weak and inconsistent: global_centroid_x raw_covariance 8.6e-7 (q 0.722), global_centroid_y 3.7e-6 (q 0.692), global_centroid_z 4.1e-7 (q 0.965), shape_xx -1.0e-6 (q 0.232), shape_yy -7.2e-5 (q 0.153), shape_zz -1.9e-5 (q 0.501). Adjusted covariance values are similarly small (global_centroid_x -1.1e-7, q 0.965; shape_yy -4.7e-5, q 0.131). These do not support a global pose or shape direction.

Clocks: observed_score_times 0.0-0.49, learning_window [0.0,0.5], curve_support [0.0,0.49], label_semantics 'Recorded affinities removed; equal score prior'. Objective is final predicted target affinity primary, validity and strain secondary, coordinate control only. Observable definitions state endpoint forecast descriptors are not atom velocities, neural attention, physical energies or causal affinity gradients. The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term. Temperatures are immutable task parameters.

hypotheses.claim: Hypothesis: pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 are the most reproducible positive coordinate hypotheses, with positive_batch_fraction 1.0 and q < 1e-4 in endpoint effects and positive adjusted_correlation (0.101, 0.084) with q 0.019 under branch adjustment. A concrete priority decision that differs from ranking point estimates alone: rank pair_kernel_2.5 above pair_kernel_1.5 because its integrated z is larger (0.631 vs 0.562) and its adjusted_correlation q is smaller (0.019 vs 0.019, with 0.084 vs 0.101), while pair_kernel_5.0 is down-weighted because positive_batch_fraction is 0.857 and q is 3.7e-3.

Hypothesis: joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A are the most batch-consistent negative coordinate hypotheses (adjusted_correlation -0.150 and -0.137, positive_batch_fraction 0.929 and 1.0, q 2.8e-4 and 9.7e-4). The counterexample that would weaken this direction is a batch with positive adjusted_correlation; the supplied positive_batch_fraction of 0.929 for joint_innovation_RMS_A indicates one opposing batch, so the direction is not unanimous.

Hypothesis: a time-conditioned rule is not supported over a constant rule for landmark_00 and landmark_01 features because the observed-node linear curves show many sign changes (4-10) and strong sign conflicts (1-18) with relative_node_RMSE 0.29-1.00 and extrapolation_allowed=false. A discriminating failure condition would be a curve with zero sign changes and relative_node_RMSE below 0.35; the supplied curves do not meet this.

Hypothesis: the large positive turnover_residual_rate values for local_cxx and local_cyy (e.g., landmark_04_local_cxx 5.671, landmark_07_local_cyy 5.633, landmark_16_local_cyy 6.367, landmark_19_local_cyy 5.368) are consistent with changing cohort composition and reclassification rather than within-path change, because the corresponding edge_rate values are negative or near zero. The residual is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect.

Hypothesis: descendant survival credit for soft_mass and local_czz is weak and mostly non-significant (landmark_00_soft_mass 0.365, q 0.120; landmark_09_local_czz -0.390, q 0.120; landmark_14_local_czz -0.308, q 0.120; landmark_15_local_czz -0.399, q 0.155; landmark_12_local_czz -1.549, q 0.034; landmark_19_local_czz -1.584, q 0.302). Without decoded terminal labels, this cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-selection versus descendant-credit comparison is unavailable.

Hypothesis: teacher contrast is predominantly internal (internal_fraction 0.787) with translation 0.132 and rotation 0.081, and atom participation 0.384, so a region that adds information beyond common motion should retain freedom in the internal coordinates while translation and rotation are less informative. The supplied tool did not perform a rigid-motion residual adjustment on region moments; adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence, and region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Observable definitions state endpoint forecast descriptors are not atom velocities, neural attention, physical energies or causal affinity gradients.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no role may propose or compile a temperature edit.
